results.statement: sc-lint must be able to export the [tool.sc-lint].runner.python venv interpreter as PYO3_PYTHON to native (non-python) steps such as cargo clippy.
results.quote:
`runner.python` only rewrites step argv; cargo clippy needs the venv interpreter exported as `PYO3_PYTHON` and the venv dir on PATH for native (non-python) steps.
[…]
We need one more knob, e.g. `runner.export_env = ["PYO3_PYTHON"]` (plus the PATH prepend in (2) applied to every step), or a per-step `env`.
results.context: Issue acceptance text: https://github.com/randlee/sc-lint/issues/198#issuecomment-6513016954 C + mismatch paragraph; in scope per Rand 2026-10-30 (re-registered from GH-198.export-env.3, ID-only change)
results.deterministic_check: A step-environment test shows a cargo clippy step receives PYO3_PYTHON set to the runner.python interpreter when configured.

relevant.instructions: Determine whether the described work falls within anchor.scope: runner config, step environment, or cargo clippy. A discussion of those topics is in scope even without the required capability.

criteria.no: The capability is omitted or explicitly rejected; merely naming its topic is insufficient.
criteria.unclear: Export behavior is described ambiguously, so inclusion of the specific capability cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item explicitly includes, preserves, or plans configurable native export of the runner.python venv interpreter as PYO3_PYTHON.

addressed.instructions: Does the item carry an explicit commitment or statement supporting native export of the runner.python venv interpreter under the name PYO3_PYTHON? No particular knob or unconditional export is required. Python-only export or a fixed system interpreter does not qualify.

criteria.no: No incompatible behavior is stated; silence and opt-in defaults are not conflict.
criteria.unclear: A stated behavior might or might not prevent the required export.
criteria.yes: An explicit behavior prevents the required native export or uses the wrong interpreter.

contradicted.instructions: Is any described planned behavior irreconcilable with ANC-032 native export capability? This includes leaving clippy unable to obtain PYO3_PYTHON or ignoring runner.python. Merely not discussing the capability is no conflict; unset defaults with configurable export are allowed.
